This bail application is filed by the accused in S.C.No.1061/2024 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court, Chengannur.
The above case arises from Crime No.652/2024 of Mannar Police Station.

The above case is registered against the petitioner and another alleging offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3), 354A(1)(i), 376(2)(f) and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 6 read with Sections 5(l) and (n), Section 8 read with Section 7, Section 10 read with Section 9 and Section 12 read with Section 11 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Sections 77 and 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act.

sentences.text: 2. Admittedly the trial in this case is already started.
Very serious allegation is there against the petitioner.
In 2024:KER:93475 BAIL APPL. NO. 9660 OF 2024 such circumstances, I am not inclined to grant bail.
The grievance of the petitioner is that she is not even able to contact a lawyer to discuss the defence of her in the case.
The trial court will make necessary arrangements to see that the petitioner interact with her lawyer.
With the above observation, this bail application is disposed of.
